guard: the permanent recovery classifier keeps exactly seven direct SDK refusal codes plus connect_failed/EACCES, while unknown codes retry

mutations.name: M1 remove handshake_failed and jcode_not_found and disable EACCES classification
mutations.expectRed: the permanent recovery contract contains exactly seven direct SDK codes plus EACCES
mutations.cell: the permanent recovery contract contains exactly seven direct SDK codes plus EACCES

mutations.name: M2 disable connect_failed EACCES classification
mutations.expectRed: the permanent recovery contract contains exactly seven direct SDK codes plus EACCES
mutations.cell: the permanent recovery contract contains exactly seven direct SDK codes plus EACCES

mutations.name: M3 make unknown HarnessError codes terminal
mutations.expectRed: an unknown HarnessError code retries inside the bounded window
mutations.cell: an unknown HarnessError code retries inside the bounded window
